Construction firms rarely slide from ordinary operation into insolvency without a preceding tail of unpaid supplier invoices, and suppliers of distressed contractors commonly obtain payment titles (Mahnbescheid, Versaeumnisurteil, Vollstreckungsbefehl) in the one-to-two years before the insolvency filing; 2024 is exactly that window. (3) Decisively, German first-instance civil judgments are not published in any public database: default judgments and payment orders in particular never appear online.
